data.title: Rove Home
data.about:
Introducing the last slice of Dubai Marina, Rove Home Branded Residences—the latest venture by Rove Hotels in collaboration with IRTH Group. Nestled in the heart of the city, these residences are a stone's throw away from Marina Mall, Dubai Marina Tram, and Metro, making it a prime location for both residents and investors.

Rove Marina by IRTH features fully-furnished studio to 2-bedroom apartments and exclusive 1- and 2-bedroom sky lofts, designed to suit modern lifestyles. These unique residences also include the innovative option to combine apartments—transform two studios into a spacious one-bedroom or merge a studio with a one-bedroom to create a luxurious two-bedroom home.

Tailored for those who value wellness and active living, Rove Home Branded Residences blend convenience, sophistication, and the vibrant energy of Dubai Marina. Embrace a lifestyle where everything you need is right at your doorstep.

characteristics_module.title: Own the Last Jewel of Dubai Marina, Rove Style!
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Prime Rove Home Location: Nestled in the heart of Dubai Marina, steps away from Dubai Marina Mall, Metro, and Tram, offering seamless connectivity to the city.
  • Stylish Rove Branded Residences: Fully-furnished, move-in-ready studios, 1- & 2-bedroom apartments in Rove Home Dubai Marina are designed with contemporary elegance and convenience in mind.
  • Flexible Payment Plan: Benefit from a buyer-friendly payment structure, making Rove Home by IRTH an ideal choice for both investors and end-users.
  • Flexible Living Spaces: Enjoy the unique option to combine two studio apartments into a spacious one-bedroom or merge a studio and a one-bedroom apartment to create a two-bedroom home, tailored to your needs.
  • World-Class Amenities: Elevate your lifestyle with luxury features, including wellness facilities, concierge services, and spaces designed for your comfort, comprising 20% of the project.
  • Convenient Parking Solutions: Each unit includes a dedicated parking space, with an additional slot available for combinable apartments, ensuring hassle-free living.

location_tile.title: Branded Residences in the Heart of Dubai Marina
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Rove Home at Dubai Marina by IRTH Development is set in a prime location, offering unmatched connectivity and convenience. Just steps from the Dubai Marina Mall, Marina promenade, Dubai Metro, and Dubai Marina Tram, residents enjoy seamless access to the best of the area. Rove Home Dubai Marina residences cater to those seeking an accessible, branded residential option that blends style and practicality. Ideal for those exploring Dubai Marina property investment opportunities, this location provides the perfect balance of urban lifestyle and luxury.

  • Dubai Marina Mall Within Walking Distance
  • DMCC Metro Station Within Walking Distance
  • 10 Minutes Walk - JBR Beach
  • 10 Minutes - Bluewaters Island
  • 10 Minutes - Palm Jumeirah

more_info.answer: Rove Home Dubai Marina offers studios, 1-bedroom, and 2-bedroom apartments, each designed to enhance urban living with modern layouts and functionality.
more_info.question: What types of residences are available at Rove Home Dubai Marina?

more_info.answer: Positioned in the heart of Dubai Marina, right next to Marina Plaza, Rove Home offers easy access to major landmarks as well as a variety of dining and entertainment options.
more_info.question: How is the location of Rove Home Dubai Marina advantageous for residents?

more_info.answer: These residences are in high demand due to their prime location, branded lifestyle amenities, and the strong market performance of Dubai Marina properties.
more_info.question: What makes Rove branded residences in Dubai Marina a good investment?

more_info.answer: Yes, the developer offers a flexible 50/50 payment plan, making Rove Home Dubai Marina an accessible investment option for buyers.
